get.summary:
Lists the active OAuth grants that cover the account identified by the given ID.
Required permissions:
- read:oauth_grants

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

post.summary:
Revokes an OAuth grant for the account identified by the given ID only.
The account is removed from the grant, so the client can no longer act in this account.
The grant stays active for the user's other accounts; it is revoked entirely only when
no accounts remain. To revoke a grant for all accounts, the user calls RevokeMyOAuthGrant.
Required permissions:
- delete:oauth_grants

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: oauthGrantId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the OAuth grant (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

get.summary:
Lists the active OAuth grants of the authenticated user.
Required permissions:
- None (authenticated only)

post.summary:
Revokes an OAuth grant of the authenticated user, for all accounts it covers.
The client loses access to every one of those accounts, and its refresh tokens are revoked.
Required permissions:
- None (authenticated only)

parameters.name: oauthGrantId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the OAuth grant (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

items.description:
The active OAuth grants that cover the account.
The account_ids of each grant only contain the requested account.

items.description: The active OAuth grants of the authenticated user.

v1ListMyOAuthGrantsResponse.title: ListMyOAuthGrantsResponse is the response from the ListMyOAuthGrants function

id.description:
Unique identifier for the OAuth grant (in GUID format).
This is a read-only field.

userId.description:
The identifier of the user who gave the consent (in GUID format).
This is a read-only field.

userEmail.description:
The email of the user who gave the consent.
This is a read-only field. It is resolved from the user's current profile when the grant is
read, not stored with the grant, so it reflects email changes. It is empty when the user can
no longer be resolved, for example after their data has been erased.

clientId.description:
The OAuth client identifier, usually the URL of the client's metadata document
(for example "https://claude.ai/oauth/mcp-client-metadata.json").
This is a read-only field.

clientName.description:
The display name of the OAuth client, taken from its metadata when the consent was given.
This is a read-only field.

scope.description:
The maximum OAuth scope the client may use.
This is a read-only field.

accountIds.description:
The identifiers of the accounts the client may act in (in GUID format).
This is a read-only field.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the consent was given.
This is a read-only field.

lastUsedAt.description:
Timestamp when the client last used the grant, if it has been used.
This is a read-only field.

v1OAuthGrant.description:
An OAuthGrant represents a user's consent that an OAuth client may act on their behalf
in one or more Qdrant Cloud accounts.
Grants are created through the OAuth consent flow, not through this API.

v1OauthScope.description:
OauthScope is the OAuth access-class for delegated credentials.
Distinct from permission verbs (read/write/delete) and from RBAC resource scope.
Wire scope strings stay "read-only" and "manage".
Named OauthScope (not OAuthScope) so enum values keep the OAUTH_SCOPE_ prefix under buf lint.

 - OAUTH_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified / unknown (or omitted on legacy events).
 - OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_ONLY: Read-class access only (wire: "read-only").
 - OAUTH_SCOPE_MANAGE: Full manage-class access (wire: "manage").

v1RevokeAccountOAuthGrantResponse.title: RevokeAccountOAuthGrantResponse is the response from the RevokeAccountOAuthGrant function

v1RevokeMyOAuthGrantResponse.title: RevokeMyOAuthGrantResponse is the response from the RevokeMyOAuthGrant function
